description: #175 — --integration-verify against a plan whose profile declares no baseline. The verification cannot run, so the phase is REFUSED before the first merge (failure / preflight_failed / integration_verify_unavailable) rather than merging and skipping the check: an opt-in verification that silently does not happen is the failure this flag exists to remove. Nothing is merged, so the operator fills in the profile and re-runs with nothing to undo. The plan is patched after the dispatch report is generated, because the plan is an INPUT to this runner and a profile with an unfilled baseline is a state a hand-written profile really reaches. #195: this is the UNDECLARED refusal — no `integration_baseline` key at all and an empty `baseline`, so `source: "baseline"` and the next action is to write one. m30 is the other refusal, where `integration_baseline` IS declared and empty, and where telling the operator to declare a baseline would be wrong.

summary_contains: profile に `baseline` を宣言してから再実行する
